description: This Java class defines the EverynetProvider, a component implementing the LoraProvider interface for handling LoRaWAN messages specific to the Everynet provider within the Eclipse Hono project. It provides methods to retrieve provider information, extract device IDs, payloads, and message types from incoming JSON messages.

classes.name: EverynetProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider with API for Everynet, implementing extraction and identification methods for Everynet-specific message format.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the provider name identifying this provider as 'everynet'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the API path prefix associated with Everynet provider.

methods.name: acceptedContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type this provider accepts, which is JSON.

methods.name: acceptedHttpMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method (POST) accepted for requests to this provider.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts and returns the device identifier from the received JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts and returns the payload content from the received JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines and returns the message type (UPLINK or UNKNOWN) based on the 'type' field in the JSON message.
